result.title: MemU-Bench: Benchmarking GUI Agents on Long-Horizon User Interactions
result.summary: Existing Graphical User Interface (GUI) benchmarks predominantly rely on precise and stateless user instructions. In everyday usage, however, instructions are often \emph{vague and history-dependent}: users omit the exact details of their past operations because they no longer remember them, leaving the agent to recover the missing context from long and noisy interaction histories. To bridge this evaluation gap, we introduce \textbf{MemU-Bench}, a mobile benchmark of \textbf{118 vague tasks} grounded in 29 long-horizon user trajectories, where agents must distill raw interaction streams into memory and retrieve the missing context on demand, with task outcomes verified against serialized application databases. Alongside Success Rate, we incorporate Interaction Efficiency (IE) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) to expose agents that succeed by exhaustively searching across different applications rather than by \emph{genuinely recalling} the history. Evaluations show that without user history, state-of-the-art systems struggle under such ambiguity: the best-performing Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves an SPL of only 16.4\%, and end-to-end GUI agents fall below 5\%. To address this, we further propose \textbf{AppMem}, a training-free framework that distills user history into a \emph{structured, app-centric} memory bank, tracks interrupted intents across application switches, and selectively retrieves relevant memories via target-app inference. AppMem raises the SPL of GPT-5.5 from 15.7\% to 66.9\% (\textbf{+51.2\%}), outperforms a naive summary baseline by 9.3\%, and delivers consistent gains across evaluated backbones.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MemU-Bench，用 118 个源自 29 条长程用户轨迹的模糊指令任务，评测 GUI agent 能否从冗长交互历史中提炼记忆并按需召回，并引入 IE、SPL 以区分「真正回忆」与穷举搜索；同时给出免训练的 AppMem 外部记忆框架。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 关注的多模态历史证据筛选、证据获取及推理成本度量直接相关；其 SPL/IE 可供核查 agent 是否真实使用记忆而非暴力搜索，但记忆是结构化外部存储而非内部 latent 状态，能否迁移到 latent 证据筛选仍需阅读判断。
